The 2nd Cohort of Solve Ambassadors: Meet Poseidon from Türkiye
Poseidon helps visually impaired swimmers navigate water environments.

With a buoy that emits constant signals and a wristband that vibrates upon detecting obstacles, the system helps users sense their surroundings and stay within designated areas—without external guidance.

Poseidon highlights new possibilities for accessibility in sports by supporting confidence and control.

Watch to see how this Top 10 Global Ambassador solution makes waves in inclusive innovation.
